Name: Happy Birthday English Content Pack
Author: Omegasis
Description:
English content pack containing gift and dialogue information for the Stardew Valley Mod Happy Birthday.

Installation

1. Make sure you have SMAPI downloaded.
2. Make sure you have the main mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/520]Happy Birthday[/url] downloaded
3. Download this mod and extract it's contents into StardewValley/Mods folder
﻿Which should look like StardewValley/Mods/HappyBirthdayContentPack en-US

4. Run the game!

Please post any bugs/issues you may pertaining to ONLY the content pack that you have here. Leave all code related crashes on the Happy Birthday mod page instead.

Thanks!
